exposure: Caregiver-mediated early language intervention (It Takes Two to Talk - ITTT) delivered in Spanish
outcome: Characteristics and themes of cultural adaptations made to the ITTT intervention
cohort: 37 Latino caregivers participated in an empirically supported caregiver-mediated early language intervention delivered in Spanish within a community nonprofit providing wrap-around support to underserved Latino children and caregivers.
finding: Cultural adaptations were made in nearly all sessions, primarily by adjusting intervention delivery methods due to contextual constraints and modifying content to include information on developmental milestones, bilingual language development, and advocacy skills.
